messages.content: Fuyutsuki: Is that what you wanted to show me?
Magi are three of myself. Me as a scientist, me as a mother, and me as a woman. These three are in conflict with each other.
Kozo: The committee's regular meeting is today, I suppose.
The city council is pure decoration. In actual fact, it's the Magi who are in charge of this city.
Maya: Magi? You mean the three super computers?
It's run by the majority rule of three types of computers. The system is exactly based on the democratic fundamentals.
Kouzou: The target of the enemy is the MAGI?
Data is being entered from all the outside networks. They are invading the MAGI system.
Maya: Is it a local invasion?
No, the signal is from the same kind of system. Germany, China, United States - invasions verified.
Maya: What is the situation?
The 4th defence area has been breached.
Makoto: What is the situation?
Main database - locked! It is impossible to stop the invasion!
Maya: What is happening?
It has entered the deeper level. Even the back-up system can not stop it.
Maya: What is the status?
The MAGI invasion has been stopped. B7-type defence system has been executed. There's no way we can be invaded for the next 62 hours.
Ritsuko: Are you finished giving the Magi their check-up?
MELCHIOR: As promised, we made it in time for today's tests.
Ritsuko: What is the status of the Magi system?
CASPER: MELCHIOR and BALTHASAR have been infected by the angel. Only CASPER remains uncorrupted.
Ritsuko: Mother, can you hear me?
Caspar opposed it! Mother... you want to protect your man and let your daughter...
